description: On the tabletop there’s a round white base plate with a short threaded post in the center, and a separate white cross-shaped piece seated over the post. The left hand stays resting on the table near the plate while the right hand reaches in from the right, grips the cross-shaped piece as a right-hand object, lifts it straight up off the post, and carries it to the right before setting it down on the tabletop and releasing it.
